RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Thursday, the July 25, 2002/Sravana  3, 1924 (Saka)
————
(Ministries :  Prime Minister; Agro and Rural Industries; Atomic Energy;
Communications and Information Technology; Consumer Affairs,
Food and Public Distribution; External Affairs; Labour;
Parliamentary Affairs; Personnel, Public Grievances and
Pensions; Planning; Road Transport and Highways;
Small Scale Industries; Space; Statistics and
Programme Implementation)
Total number of questions—154
Export of Agro-products to Australia
876. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO: Will the Minister of AGRO AND
RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that India has a
vast potential and better market access for
its products in Australia;
(b) if so, the details of the opportunities
that the Indian agro and rural industries have
in  Australia; and
(c) the steps being taken by his Ministry
to export more and more agro products to
Australia?
Deteriorating rural and cottage
industries
†877. SHRI KRIPAL PARMAR: Will
the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the fact that the condition of traditional rural
cottage industries is continuously
deteriorating;
(b) if so, the steps Government propose
to take to promote rural industries; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
PMRY in HP
878. SHRI ANIL SHARMA: Will the
Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the targets set up to
generate employment opportunities under
the Pradhan Mantri Rozgar Yojana in
Himachal Pradesh during the last three
years, district-wise; and
(b) the number of educated unemployed
persons who have been benefited in the State
during the above period?
Production and sale by KVIC
†879. SHRI MUNAVVAR HASAN:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the production and sale made by the
Khadi and Village Industries Commission
during each of the last three years;
(b) the details of the personnel working
in various categories for the last three years
at the different sales centres in Delhi;

Evaluation study of PMRY
880. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR : Will
the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether any evaluation study of the
Pradhan Mantri Rozgar Yojana has been
made; and
(b) if so, what are the details for the last
three years, State-wise?
Allotment of funds through KVIC
881. DR. VIJAY MALLYA: Will the
Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the allotment of funds to various
NGOs for the promotion of Khadi and
Village Industries through KVIC since 1998
year-wise and State-wise;
(b) whether it is a fact that a number of
applications from Karnataka have been
rejected during the last year, if so, the reasons
therefor; and
(c) whether Government are planning to
establish a regional office in Karnataka to
promote Khadi industry?
Khadi industries in Bihar
†882. SHRIMATI KUM KUM RAI:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether any special scheme has been
formulated and implemented by the Khadi
and Village Industries Commission to
promote khadi and village industry in Bihar;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Cottage industries in  Andhra Pradesh
883. DR. DASARI NARAYANA
RAO: Will the Minister of AGRO AND
RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have any action
plan or package for the over all development
of cottage industries in Andhra Pradesh;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) what is the present status of cottage
industries in the State with details thereof?
Environmental delay for nuclear
power programme
884. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY: Will the PRIME
MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
environmental delays are hampering projects
meant to provide raw material for the nuclear
power programme;
(b) whether Government have identified
any areas for setting up of atomic power
stations;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) the action contemplated thereon?
